name: GitHub Issues
description: Ingest issues and comments from GitHub repositories, with software version, labels and error signatures

config.label: Repositories (owner/name or a GitHub URL, one per line)
Only issues with any of these labels (optional, comma-separated)
Product names cited with a version (optional, e.g. Kiro)
Only issues and comments created on or after (optional, YYYY-MM-DD)
Skip authors with these GitHub roles (optional, e.g. OWNER, MEMBER, COLLABORATOR)

setup.title: GitHub Issues Setup
steps: Create a fine-grained personal access token limited to the repositories you list
Grant it read-only Issues and Metadata permissions and nothing else
Paste the token and the repositories above (one owner/name or GitHub URL per line)
Optionally restrict to labels, and name the product so 'Kiro 0.4.2' is read as a version
For a large repository, set a start date and skip maintainer roles: every ingested item costs a model call
Enable the schedule to poll every 30 minutes
For real-time delivery add a repository webhook (issues, issue_comment) to /webhooks/github_issues with content type application/json and the same secret
